description: The Power of Interactive and Dynamic Excel-like Tables The SuperTables Visual for Power BI enables a highly interactive and flexible experience by bringing Excel-like pivot table functionalities directly into Power BI reports with writeback capabilities through our product WriteBackExtreme. No workarounds, no switching programs, empowers end-users to customize their data views with bookmarks, including grouping, filtering, pivoting data, editing and adding new data, making it indispensable for organizations that require dynamic, on-demand data analysis directly in their reporting environment. SuperTables is perfect for users who need detailed data analysis beyond Power BI’s standard tables, which saves time and preserves data integrity within the Power BI ecosystem. SuperTables is built for everyone. SuperTables targets business analysts, data teams, and decision-makers in industries where data reporting and dynamic analysis are critical, such as finance, healthcare, retail, manufacturing, and more. Organizations that rely on Power BI for reporting but require additional flexibility and interactivity in their data presentations will benefit significantly from SuperTables. InputTables InputTables is a combination of the powers of WriteBackExtreme and SuperTables.
